fallback_policy: NO Windows/NTFS fallback exists. The facade routes repository-tree creation exclusively to the qualified R4-C object-authoritative Materializer (local git ls-tree / cat-file). It never copies the Windows working tree, never uses shutil.copytree, never treats NTFS or host-working-tree executable bits as authority. Blank inputs fail closed at the seam (MaterializeError).
